sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5travel puzzle PAINTED CLEAN BACKGROUND. Scene: A neighborhood square decorated with little pennants. View: eye-level intimate view. Polished warm storybook digital painting matching the approved Art Direction V2 game boards: tactile softly brushed surfaces, gentle sunlight, dimensional illustrated objects, clean local colour separation and rich small discoveries. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. Dominant main colour: coral pink (#D99B96), clearly occupying the largest coherent surfaces, with balanced contrasting details. Composition is generic travel subject matter; NO recognizable destination landmarks, city names, signs, letters or logos. No UI or border. This is a finished clean plate for five separately painted motion details. Paint complete underlying surfaces at all five declared positions; do not draw the five named foreground details, leave no transparent hole or blank placeholder. Portrait master1280x1600. Part placements for later composition: a narrow hanging pennant appropriate to the neighborhood at normalised rect [0.17, 0.1, 0.18, 0.14]; a little flowering window-box sprig at normalised rect [0.73, 0.3, 0.18, 0.18]; a softly draped curtain corner in one window at normalised rect [0.36, 0.22, 0.13, 0.19]; a small foreground branch entering from the left at normalised rect [0.05, 0.66, 0.19, 0.23]; a soft cloud or pale reflection in this scene at normalised rect [0.49, 0.08, 0.22, 0.12]. The painting must remain attractive and complete underneath those parts.
MANDATORY FULLY OPAQUE RGB painting with alpha255 everywhere; no transparent regions or translucent painted background. Refinement: Small cosy neighbourhood square with CORAL PINK plaster house walls around a modest cobblestone clearing, coral flowering window boxes and a few cream-and-coral pennants overhead. Warm cream paving with coral wall reflections. No fountain monument, statue, tower, destination landmark, signs, shop names, text, people, vehicles or famous architecture. Small planters, quiet bench, pastel morning light. Predominantly soft coral pink, much lighter than deep berry roses. No UI, border, logo or lettering. This is a fully finished clean plate, portrait4:5.
